rows.note: Use this for a professional qualification or credential that a person holds.

example.english: I have the certification needed to do this job.
example.traditional: 我有專業資格，可以做呢份工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 zyun1 jip6 zi1 gaak3 ho2 ji5 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the process or status of certifying something.

example.english: This product hasn't completed certification yet.
example.traditional: 呢個產品仲未完成認證。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 zung6 mei6 jyun4 sing4 jing6 zing3

rows.note: Use this specifically for an authority issuing or granting a certificate.

example.english: The government will only issue the certification next month.
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 jiu3 haa6 go3 jyut6 sin1 faat3 zing3
